description: "The Dodge Club; Or, Italy in MDCCCLIX" by James De Mille is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around a group of American travelers, known as the Dodge Club, who embark on a journey through France and Italy, encountering various humorous situations and cultural misunderstandings along the way.
